summary: Verified deployed capital as single source of truth for position sizing and return calculations. All 15 backend tests passed. Key verifications: 1) config.DEPLOYED_CAPITAL = $8000 (80% of $10000), 2) config.MAX_POSITION_SIZE = $240 (3% of deployed), 3) PolymarketPositionSizer uses max_deployable_capital as sizing_base, 4) Utilization = deployed/max_deployable (not deployed/equity), 5) Sector caps based on deployed capital, 6) BacktestEngine uses deployed_capital for returns and Sharpe, 7) RiskController uses config.DEPLOYED_CAPITAL for Sharpe calculation, 8) API endpoints return correct sizing_base=$8000 and max_single_position=$240 in trade breakdowns.

polymarket_position_sizer.py: Max single position = sizing_base × max_position_size_pct (line 298)
